description: This file defines the 'EventHubMessage' class, which models a message originating from Azure Event Hubs within the Orleans streaming infrastructure. It includes constructors for creating message instances from parameters or cached data, and properties that represent message metadata such as stream ID, partition key, offset, sequence number, timestamps, user properties, and payload.

classes.name: EventHubMessage
classes.description: Represents an EventHub message with metadata and payload, tailored for use within Orleans streaming. Implements serialization attributes and constructors to rebuild from cached data.

properties.name: EnqueueTimeUtc
properties.description: Time event was written to EventHub

properties.name: DequeueTimeUtc
properties.description: Time event was read from EventHub and added to cache

methods.name: EventHubMessage
methods.description: Constructor initializing from parameters including stream ID, partition key, offset, sequence number, timestamps, properties, and payload.

methods.name: EventHubMessage
methods.description: Constructor reconstructing the message from cached data and a serializer, reading segment data.
